metas.name: Past Lives
metas.description:
Captures the life that didn't happen, with nobody in the wrong. Childhood sweethearts from Seoul reconnect in New York 24 years later — she is happily married — and have kind, adult conversations about the road not taken.

Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Twenty years later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront notions of love and destiny.

metas.name: Paterson
metas.description:
Captures a routine life as a work of art. One week with a bus driver named Paterson, in Paterson, who writes poems about matchboxes and waterfalls between shifts.

A quiet observation of the triumphs and defeats of daily life, along with the poetry evident in its smallest details.

metas.name: Columbus
metas.description:
Captures two people keeping each other company inside their own stalled grief. A son stuck in Indiana while his father is in a coma meets a young woman who loves the town's modernist buildings and cannot leave her mother.

A Korean-born man finds himself stuck in Columbus, Indiana, where his architect father is in a coma. The man meets a young woman who wants to stay in Columbus with her mother, a recovering addict, instead of pursuing her own dreams.

metas.name: Before Sunrise
metas.description:
Captures falling for someone through conversation alone. Two strangers on a train spend one night walking and talking in Vienna until a morning flight.

A young man and woman meet on a train in Europe, and wind up spending one evening together in Vienna. Unfortunately, both know that this will probably be their only night together.

metas.name: In the Mood for Love
metas.description:
Captures longing held back on purpose. Two neighbours in 1960s Hong Kong learn their spouses are cheating with each other, fall for each other, and refuse to do the same thing.

Two neighbors form a strong bond after both suspect extramarital activities of their spouses. However, they agree to keep their bond platonic so as not to commit similar wrongs.

metas.name: Scenes from a Marriage
metas.description:
Captures a marriage being taken apart in dialogue. A couple first interviewed as 'ideal' are revisited over years of separation, affairs, and still needing each other.

Chronicles the many years of love and turmoil that bind Marianne and Johan through matrimony, infidelity, divorce, and subsequent partners.

metas.name: Blue Valentine
metas.description:
Captures love decaying, cross-cut with it beginning. The same couple early and late, and the late scenes are unbearable precisely because the early ones were real.

A couple cannot halt the downward spiral of their marriage.

metas.name: Moonlight
metas.description:
Captures a self forming under pressure, in three ages. One boy in Miami at 9, 16 and adult — bullied, desired, armoured — told almost entirely in looks and silences.

A young African-American man grapples with his identity and sexuality while experiencing the everyday struggles of childhood, adolescence, and burgeoning adulthood.

metas.name: Election
metas.description:
Captures ambition so pure it becomes frightening, at a high school. A student election, a teacher who decides one candidate must be stopped, and everyone's voiceover giving their self-justifying version.

A high school teacher meets his match in an over-achieving student politician.

metas.name: A Brighter Summer Day
metas.description:
Captures adolescence inside a whole society holding its breath. Taipei, 1960 — exiled mainland families, street gangs, Elvis, a famous murder case — four hours that build a world rather than a plot.

Based on a true story, primarily on a conflict between two youth gangs, a 14-year-old boy's girlfriend conflicts with the head of one gang for an unclear reason, until finally the conflict comes to a violent climax.

metas.name: Yi Yi
metas.description:
Captures every age of a family seeing only one side of life. Taipei, three hours, a wedding at the start and a funeral at the end — including a little son photographing the backs of people's heads so they can see what they can't.

Portrait of a middle-class family in Taipei. A man in his forties, his teenage daughter and his eight-year-old son experience life, navigating between remorse, hope and disappointment.

metas.name: Amour
metas.description:
Captures marriage at the point where love becomes physical care. An elderly Paris couple, a stroke, a promise not to go back to hospital, one apartment — no softening, and tender anyway.

Georges and Anne are an octogenarian couple. They are cultivated, retired music teachers. Their daughter, also a musician, lives in Britain with her family. One day, Anne has a stroke, and the couple's bond of love is severely tes...

metas.name: Close
metas.description:
Captures two boys' intimacy being seen, and what being seen does to it. Best friends at 13, inseparable all summer, then school starts and other kids ask what they are.

The intense friendship between two thirteen-year old boys Leo and Remi suddenly gets disrupted. Struggling to understand what has happened, Léo approaches Sophie, Rémi's mother. "Close" is a film about friendship and responsibility.

metas.name: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
metas.description:
Captures desire as the act of looking carefully. Brittany, 1770: a painter commissioned to paint a bride-to-be in secret, because the woman refuses to sit for the portrait that will be sent to her future husband.

On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

metas.name: Carol
metas.description:
Captures restrained desire in a world with everything to lose. 1950s New York, a shopgirl and an older woman in a custody fight — glances across a toy counter, a road trip, composure in every public room.

An aspiring photographer develops an intimate relationship with an older woman in 1950s New York.

metas.name: Happy Together
metas.description:
Captures a couple who keep saying 'let's start over' and mean it every time. Two Hong Kong men in Buenos Aires, breaking up and reuniting in cycles, with the Iguazu Falls as the place they never quite reach together.

A couple take a trip to Argentina but both men find their lives drifting apart in opposite directions.

metas.name: Call Me by Your Name
metas.description:
Captures first desire as a summer education of the senses. Italy, 1983 — peaches, swimming, an older grad student in the house — and a father's talk near the end that reframes the whole film.

In the summer of 1983, 17-year-old Elio is spending the days with his family at their villa in Lombardy, Italy. He soon meets 24-year-old Oliver, an intern working for Elio's father. They discover the heady beauty of awakening des...

metas.name: The Remains of the Day
metas.description:
Captures a life spent not saying the thing. An English butler who gave everything to duty drives after the war to visit the housekeeper he loved, composing each sentence too late.

A butler sacrifices love for duty in 1930s England.

metas.name: Chungking Express
metas.description:
Captures city loneliness at pop speed. Hong Kong, two lovesick cops, expired pineapple cans, and a snack-bar girl breaking into a man's flat to clean it while 'California Dreamin'' loops.

Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious female underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal waitress at a late-night restaurant he frequents.

metas.name: Y Tu Mamá También
metas.description:
Captures youth burning brightly over a country it isn't looking at. Two teenage boys and an older woman drive to a beach that may not exist, while the narrator quietly tells you the futures and the roadside Mexico they pass.

In Mexico, two teenage boys and an older woman embark on a road trip and learn a thing or two about life and each other.

metas.name: The Apartment
metas.description:
Captures loneliness in a big company, and kindness as a decision. An insurance clerk lends his flat to executives for their affairs to get promoted, loves the elevator girl from afar, and hits Christmas at the lowest point of both.

A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but office politics and his own romantic hopes complicate matters.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description:
Captures a lonely young woman engineering small happinesses for strangers. Montmartre, a tin of childhood treasures returned to its owner, and a heroine who can fix everyone's life except ask for anything in her own.

Despite being caught in her imaginative world, young waitress Amelie decides to help people find happiness. Her quest to spread joy leads her on a journey during which she finds true love.

metas.name: Singin' in the Rain
metas.description:
Captures pure performed joy, inside a story about an industry panicking. Hollywood switching to sound, a star with a terrible voice, and musical numbers that still feel like showing off for the love of it.

When Hollywood's silent era gives way to talkies, a dashing screen idol and a gifted newcomer navigate romance, rivalry, and the comic chaos of reinventing the movies.

metas.name: Big Night
metas.description:
Captures two brothers arguing about whether a meal should be art or business. Italian immigrants, a failing restaurant, one elaborate dinner to save it, and a final wordless scene of one cooking breakfast for the other.

New Jersey, 1950s. Two brothers run an Italian restaurant. Business is not going well as a rival Italian restaurant is out-competing them. In a final effort to save the restaurant, the brothers plan to put on an evening of incredi...

metas.name: Rushmore
metas.description:
Captures a precocious teenager's grandiosity as a grief strategy. A scholarship kid who runs every club and stages huge plays falls for a widowed teacher and goes to war with a sad industrialist who is, emotionally, the same age.

A teenager at Rushmore Academy falls for a much older teacher and befriends a middle-aged industrialist. Later, he finds out that his love interest and his friend are having an affair, which prompts him to begin a vendetta.

metas.name: Day for Night
metas.description:
Captures a film set as a chaotic temporary family. Truffaut plays the director of a mediocre melodrama, keeping affairs, breakdowns, accidents and deadlines moving toward a finished film nobody thinks is great and everybody needs.

A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

metas.name: Oslo, August 31st
metas.description:
Captures a man visiting his own life while on leave from rehab. Job interview, old friends, a party, the family home for sale — Oslo in late summer light, conversations so ordinary they are painful for what he hears in them.

One day in the life of Anders, a young recovering drug addict, who takes a brief leave from his treatment center to interview for a job and catch up with old friends in Oslo.

metas.name: Weekend
metas.description:
Captures intimacy with an expiration date already on it. Two men meet in Nottingham on a Friday, one leaving the country on Sunday, and talk in bed, pubs and trains about sex, coming out, and how much of yourself you perform.

After a drunken house party with his straight mates, Russell heads out to a gay club. Just before closing time he picks up Glen but what's expected to be just a one-night stand becomes something else, something special.

metas.name: God's Own Country
metas.description:
Captures a man who can only express feeling through work and drink learning tenderness from lambing. A young Yorkshire farmer, mud and silence, and a Romanian migrant worker hired for the season who is gentle in a way he has no defences for.

Spring. Yorkshire. Young farmer Johnny Saxby numbs his daily frustrations with binge drinking and casual sex, until the arrival of a Romanian migrant worker for lambing season ignites an intense relationship that sets Johnny on a ...

metas.name: Brokeback Mountain
metas.description:
Captures a love conducted in a few weeks a year, across twenty years. Wyoming herders, marriages and children in between, and a shirt kept in a closet doing more work than any speech.

Two shepherds fall for each other, but their relationship becomes complicated when they both get married to their respective girlfriends.

metas.name: Her
metas.description:
Captures loneliness in a warm, well-designed future. A divorced man who writes other people's love letters for a living falls for a voice in his ear, and the film takes the relationship seriously enough to let it outgrow him.

In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: Gattaca
metas.description:
Captures a caste system built from a blood sample. A man born without genetic screening borrows another man's blood, urine and identity to reach space, while his 'valid' brother keeps challenging him to swimming races neither should survive.

Vincent, an "In-Valid," assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation. However, a week before his mission, a murder marks Vincent as a suspect.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description:
Captures trying to keep someone while paying to forget them. A couple erase each other after a breakup; inside the procedure, mid-deletion, he changes his mind and hides her in childhood memories the technicians haven't reached.

When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: Make Way for Tomorrow
metas.description:
Captures old parents becoming an inconvenience to distribute. In the Depression a couple lose their house and their adult children split them between households 'temporarily' — politeness does the damage, and the farewell scene is unforgettable.

An elderly couple are forced to live hundreds of miles apart when they lose their house and none of their five children will take both parents in.

metas.name: All About Eve
metas.description:
Captures ambition wearing perfect manners. A young fan insinuates herself into a Broadway star's life one helpful errand at a time; the dialogue is the sharpest ever written for this, and every adult sees the game a moment too late.

A seemingly timid but secretly ruthless ingénue insinuates herself into the lives of an aging Broadway star and her circle of theater friends.

metas.name: Notorious
metas.description:
Captures love being used as an intelligence asset. A woman is recruited to marry into a Nazi circle in Rio because of who her father was, by an agent unable to say the one thing that would make it bearable.

The daughter of a convicted German spy is asked by American agents to gather information on a ring of German scientists in South America. How far will she have to go to ingratiate herself with them?

metas.name: Blue Is the Warmest Colour
metas.description:
Captures first love at the resolution of skin, food and class difference. A schoolgirl in Lille and an older art student with blue hair — long scenes of eating, talking and teaching, and a breakup stretched across years of growing into different worlds.

Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire and to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adèle grows, seeks herself, loses herself, and ...

metas.name: Secretary
metas.description:
Captures kink as, for one specific person, a form of self-knowledge. A young woman fresh out of hospital for self-harm takes a typing job with a demanding lawyer, in a relationship the film treats as tender rather than a diagnosis.

A timid young woman starts working for a demanding lawyer and finds a new way to deal with her self-harming urges.

metas.name: Lust, Caution
metas.description:
Captures an espionage performance becoming the real feeling it was faking. In occupied Shanghai, a student actress is assigned to seduce a collaborationist official so he can be killed, over years of mahjong games and assignations.

During World War II era, a young woman, Wang Jiazhi, gets swept up in a dangerous game of emotional intrigue with a powerful political figure, Mr. Yee.

metas.name: In the Realm of the Senses
metas.description:
Captures obsession with the outside world switched off. 1930s Japan, a hotel maid and her employer in a room, in a spiral based on a real case — explicit as claustrophobia, not titillation.

A fictionalized retelling of the story of Sada Abe, whose affair with her master quickly turned obsessive and sadomasochistic.

metas.name: Touki Bouki
metas.description:
Captures two young people dreaming of Paris so hard the film itself starts hallucinating. Senegal: a cowherd and a student steal and scheme toward a ship, on a motorbike with a skull mounted on it, in editing that jumps like a skipping song.

Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

metas.name: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
metas.description:
Captures a vampire film rebuilt from Iranian, Western and skate-punk parts. A fictional Iranian ghost town, a chador-wearing vampire on a skateboard, a drug dealer and a cat, in long black-and-white silences between bursts of pop.

In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

metas.name: Atlantics
metas.description:
Captures young men who leave by sea returning in another form. Dakar construction workers, unpaid for months, take a boat toward Spain; the film stays with the women left behind, the sea at night, and a love story conducted through possession and fever.

In a popular suburb of Dakar, workers on the construction site of a futuristic tower, without pay for months, decide to leave the country by the ocean for a better future. Among them is Souleiman, the lover of Ada, promised to ano...

metas.name: Brief Encounter
metas.description:
Captures desire that obeys the rules anyway. A doctor and a housewife meet in a railway station café, fall in love in weekly instalments, and give each other up — two ordinary people torn apart by behaving well.

Meeting a stranger in a railway station, a woman is tempted to cheat on her husband.

metas.name: The Worst Person in the World
metas.description:
Captures turning thirty with every option still open and none chosen. Oslo in twelve chapters: a woman cycles through careers and men, including a night that pauses the entire city so she can test a life before living it.

The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.

metas.name: Marketa Lazarová
metas.description:
Captures a whole civilisation changing gods. Medieval Bohemia in deep winter — pagan and Christian clans, wolf packs, kidnapped nuns, mud and chanting — with Shadows' savage lyricism stretched to epic scale. Frequently called the greatest Czech film.

A grim portrayal of the shift from Paganism to Christianity in medieval central Europe - as a young virgin promised to God is kidnapped and raped by a marauder who her religious father seeks to kill in return.

metas.name: Gabbeh
metas.description:
Captures storytelling embedded in a folk object. A nomad tribe's woven carpet unfolds as it is washed in a river: the girl in the pattern tells her own story of forbidden love, in colours as saturated as Parajanov's Carpathians.

When an old couple washes their gabbeh - a type of Persian rug - a young woman magically appears and tells them her life story.

metas.name: Days of Heaven
metas.description:
Captures labour, land and sky at a scale that makes human betrayal look like weather passing through it. Malick's wheat-harvest tragedy, shot almost entirely at magic hour and narrated by a child who only half understands the adults around her.

A hot-tempered farm laborer convinces the woman he loves to marry their rich but dying boss so that they can have a claim to his fortune.

metas.name: The Piano
metas.description:
Captures desire conducted entirely through objects, landscape and music. Campion's mute Scottish bride arrives in colonial New Zealand, and her piano, left on the beach by her husband, becomes the currency of a wordless negotiation in bush and mud that feel mythic.

In the mid-19th century a mute woman is sent to New Zealand along with her young daughter and prized piano for an arranged marriage to a farmer, but is soon lusted after by a farm worker.

metas.name: Raise the Red Lantern
metas.description:
Captures ritual as an instrument of control. Zhang Yimou confines a 1920s household drama to one courtyard compound, where the master's nightly choice of wife is announced by red lanterns and foot massages — rules never fully explained, which is how the women live them.

A young woman becomes the fourth concubine of a wealthy man and soon realizes there's fierce competition for his attention and the associated privileges.

metas.name: Calendar
metas.description:
Captures diaspora as a loop of beautiful images you can't live inside. Egoyan sends a Canadian photographer to Armenia to shoot twelve ancient churches for a calendar, his marriage failing in the car between sites — then the ritual repeats, reframed, back in Toronto.

A woman stays in Armenia after her photographer husband completes his assignment and returns home to Canada.

metas.name: Shadows of Forgotten Ancestors
metas.description:
Captures a folk tale carried by image and ritual rather than plot. Parajanov's Hutsul lovers Ivan and Marichka move through Carpathian weddings, funerals and seasons in whirling camera work, saturated colour and embroidered imagery. The film Filip confirmed watching and enjoying.

A timeless Carpathian story - the young Ivan falls in love with the daughter of his father's killer among the Hutsul people of Ukraine.
